correctness.rationale: In the physical region total population including D is conserved, and (R_i+D_i)(t)=k_i∫I_i≤N_i0 gives N_i(t)≥(1−q_i)N_i0. Integrated infection pressure is finite, so S_i∞>0; bounded derivatives and integrable I_i give I_i∞=0. Integration of d log N_i or its constant-denominator q_i=0 limit yields the displayed Φ_q and the final-size map on h≥0. Positive seeds and nonzero input in every row give F(0)>0 componentwise. The map is increasing, bounded and componentwise concave. A compact order interval gives existence, and comparing two positive fixed points at their largest coordinate ratio, using F(rv)≤rF(v)−(r−1)F(0), gives uniqueness in the physical orthant. The tangent inequality gives DF(h)h≤F(h)−F(0)<h, so the weighted maximum norm implies ρ(J)<1 without irreducibility. Implicit differentiation at fixed k and initial state gives (I−J)∂h/∂q_j=K_:j w_j, then ∂z_i/∂h_i=1−z_i; the q_j=0 derivative is one-sided in the admissible domain. Every term J^rK has the support of walks of length r+1, and all scalar factors of the derivative are positive. Distinct endpoints therefore require reachability and self-influence requires a positive-length return, including a self-loop. Fixed exit leaves both reference next-generation matrices and mean infectious duration independent of q; freezing the denominator eliminates q from the (S,I) equations. An independent bounded fixed-point check reproduced the two displayed final infection vectors, ρ(K)=2.02284161, and the analytic first sensitivity column matched a central difference at step 10⁻⁵. The frozen checker was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: The uniqueness assertion is for h≥0, not all algebraic solutions under formal continuation.

value.rationale: This mathematical comparison isolates an effect invisible to the reference reproduction threshold and absent in the fixed-denominator model. Rather than simply proving aggregate monotonicity, it gives exact target-wise support even when the contact matrix is reducible, including a criterion for no self-response despite a source perturbation. That distinction matters when interpreting what this model's normalizations do and do not encode.
residual_risks: Value is an exact comparison of abstract equations; no clinical or empirical prescription is derived.
